Install using a USB drive

Open the APK from a USB drive using your TV’s file manager.

Requires Android TV or Google TV on Android 8.0 or newer, with APK installation allowed.

  1. Download the APK. Open the signed preview release and download sweep-tv.apk from Assets.
  2. Copy the APK to the drive. Use a computer or a phone that can write to the drive. Eject the drive after copying.
  3. Plug it into your TV. Open the drive in a file manager, choose the APK, and allow installation from that file manager if Android asks. Select Install, then open Sweep TV from Apps.
If the drive does not appear

Check the filesystem and USB-drive support in your TV’s manual. You can also use Android phone transfer.
